native_mechanisms: Grey wax trough: each mark's impression is pressed atop all prior impressions before any can cool, so no single mark stays legible — only the churned sum of every collision.
Seven bell-jars of differently-tuned swarms bite a dipped wire in fixed counts, carried to a forward-only slate wheel so no bite can ever be cancelled/walked off.
A single brine plunge freezes the accumulated bite-pattern into a six-flower frost lattice, held until the lace stops spreading, and only that lattice sketch survives as the token.
core_technique: XXH3/wyhash-style buffer hash: parallel keyed lanes (7 at ≥112B, 2 at ≥32B) each updated by a 64×64→128 multiply folded hi^lo plus rotate-and-add, depth-2 multiply tree merge, overlapping-read tail, then a Murmur3/SplitMix-style multiply-xor-shift finalizer seeded with the length.
